why: The population-statistics gates in tests/test_rating_distribution.py (curated/fitted SD gap, corr(score, log pop), corr(beauty, log pop)) are pooled statistics: adding a homogeneous stratum of small places moves them with no per-destination score changing. They are asserted on this fixed reference population - the catalogue the thresholds were derived on - so they measure the model, not the census. Full-catalogue values stay printed beside them.
